picks.verdict: Bucharest's only globally ranked bar — botanical cocktail laboratory in the 19th-century Palatul Universul.

picks.name: Origo
picks.verdict: Bucharest's most-reviewed bar — 4.7★ across nearly 5,000 reviews. World-class coffee and cocktails.

picks.verdict: Highest-rated cocktail bar in Bucharest — theatrical 'Potion Bar' concept with genuinely excellent drinks.

picks.name: Ginoteca
picks.verdict: Near-perfect 4.9★ — gin-focused specialist on one of Bucharest's most charming streets.

picks.name: Interbelic
picks.verdict: 1930s-inspired cocktail lounge capturing Bucharest's interwar golden age.

picks.name: Oficiul 1
picks.verdict: Bucharest's OG speakeasy — intimate, well-curated, genuinely feels like a discovery.

picks.name: SIPPERS Bucharest
picks.verdict: Perfect 5.0★ from 771 reviews — exceptional cocktails and legendarily friendly service.

picks.name: Twisted Olives x SUPA DUPA

picks.name: The Owl Cocktail House

picks.name: Nope Speakeasy Bar
picks.verdict: Bucharest's newest and most genuinely hidden speakeasy — discover it before everyone else.

picks.name: Perfetto Bar

picks.name: Freddo Bar & Lounge
picks.verdict: Old Town institution — 6,000+ reviews, affordable cocktails, and always delivers.
